description: Form 1040 (2025), line 2b: exact seven-family positive taxable interest less four separately closed adjustment classes: the three contributed Schedule B classes (Nominee Distribution, Accrued Interest, ABP Adjustment) and the accrued interest derived by adopted rule from recorded obligation-acquisition circumstances.

blocked.explain: Taxable interest is blocked because one or more constituent interest families are unclosed, their dependencies are missing, or a recorded obligation acquisition has not been shown to concern exactly one recorded interest report.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because all constituent families are attested closed on their current horizons with no recorded members.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present subtotals that sum to zero. All constituent families are closed.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No taxable-interest value is published because the explicit adjustment classes exceed the positive-interest basis.

published_value.explain: A current cited derived finding publishes the seven-family positive interest total less the exact contributed and closed Schedule B adjustment classes and the derived obligation-acquisition accrued-interest class.

label: Taxable interest
